preprocessing.target_method: empirical mid-rank percentile of a simulated soil store against a frozen reference period
preprocessing.missing_month_policy: months with no simulated clear observation are omitted, not filled
preprocessing.note: Toy dynamics with no land-surface physics. Features are invented summaries; VCI is not computed from imagery and the target is not FLDAS soil moisture.

known_limitations: Scores on this data measure software behaviour and nothing about drought accuracy.
Regions share one synthetic climate signal, so held-out-region results are optimistic relative to real geographic transfer.
